idea-plugin.name: Duke Engine
idea-plugin.description:
Editor support for the INI files that hold a Duke Engine game's content: its units, its world and its settings. Duke Engine is a deterministic Java game engine; block types and fields are read from the game's own code, so the plugin knows no particular game.
  • Highlighting for block headers, End, keys, values, numbers, strings and ; comments
  • Sections inside a block, as a World block holds them: Generation = Layout, its fields and an End of its own
  • Folding for every block, module and section, and a structure view listing them
  • Checks for unclosed blocks, stray End lines and unrecognized lines
  • Ctrl+Click from a block name used elsewhere, such as the hero a skill belongs to, to its definition
  • Module names and module fields completed and checked against the engine's Module classes on the project classpath; Ctrl+Click from a module name to its class
  • A warning where ModuleFactory.register gives a module a name other than its class name, with a quick fix
  • Asset paths, each written whole from the resource root (Model = models/heroes/rogue.glb), completed there, checked with exact letter case, and opened by Ctrl+Click
  • Duke Inspector tool window: the selected INI file as a form, with a checkbox, a list of files, block names or animation clips, or a text field for each field, modules added by group, sections, and the blocks a unit is missing offered in one click
  • File > New > Duke Unit: an empty unit or a renamed copy, added to the game's list of files
Every .ini file opens as Duke INI. The fields of blocks and sections are not checked; a module's are.

action.description: Create a unit's INI file and add it to the game's list of files
